title: Flue area (appliance).
officialText:
Chimney flues shall not be smaller in area than the area of the connector from the appliance.
Chimney flues connected to more than one appliance shall not be less than the area of the largest connector plus 50 percent o f the
areas of additional chimney connectors.
Exceptions:
1. Chimney flues serving oil-fired appliances sized in accordance with the New York City Mechanical Code and NFPA 31.
2. Chimney flues serving gas-fired appliances sized in accordance with the New York City Fuel Gas Code.
